consequence: the squared SEC numerators inherit a t^2 factor, so L_SEC is approximately proportional to t^2

prereg_sentence: The endpoint structural auxiliary inherits the natural t-dependent scaling of the direct t->0 endpoint construction. No inverse-t normalization is applied.
